reviews.title: My Only Way to Shop!
reviews.body: Started using Stitch Fix when I realized how ‘challenged’ I was when it came to putting together a business casual wardrobe for my new job. The SF stylists sent me versatile pieces that grew my wardrobe not only for work, but for casual and even working out. There is a Stylist Note feature and they will send you specific requests, such as ‘I need some black jeans’. It couldn’t be easier—send back the pieces you don’t want, review the box before it’s sent and select or discard items, even ask for a different stylist (I love my current stylist and choose to keep her each time!) I have never gotten so many compliments and have learned what I like in clothes! Love that you can even shop on your own and the sizes are already built in. And the shoes!! Just be as detailed as possible on the style questionnaire with sizes, preferences and price point. reviews.title: Never what I asked for
reviews.body: Just peeked at next fix. I don’t know why I bother to write suggestions to the person picking my fix, because nothing I say is ever regarded. Pants always shorter than my inseam length. Multiple pants suggested when I rarely wear them in FL. I said no pastels or whites-both in fix. Over age 60 - no knit bodycon dresses or 4” shorts. Hi neckline & sweater fabric not appropriate here in FL, but usually included in fix. Flannel pants even in last fix-for FL??? WTH?! Can the stylist you hire actually read??? I don’t understand why my notes to stylist are ignored. Even AI should do better than this. This will probably be my last fix because it’s not saving me time by suggesting stuff I blatantly told it I did not want. Then I have to waste time driving to FedEx to return it. I tell it my body type, things I hate, the weather here and fix suggests clothing inappropriate for most of it. Is there no one there that can tastefully and cutely style a fun woman over 60?

A Reformation dress that you wear once and throw away is not necessarily sustainable, even though the brand rates very highly on this app. 

It’s a well designed enough app, with some cool features, but for anyone whose been into sustainability for a while, it lacks nuance. The app seems mostly like a way to encourage shoppers to buy expensive brands, which not all of us can afford. 

An H&M shirt that you’ve had for five years is still sustainable - in its own way. The most important part is keeping your clothes and caring for them in whatever way you can to avoid creating waste. 

If you’re new to these concepts the app might be fun, if not, I wouldn’t recommend it for the purposes of sustainability

终于找到想要的 APP 了，但还是有一些没有达到预期，提一些我的小小建议，希望可以采纳
1.希望真正是一个好的工具，而不是一个为淘宝导流的 APP。毕竟大家的衣服并不都是来自淘宝。
更开发者可以强调它的工具属性，把社区和购买的建议放在后面。不然会像蘑菇街一样黄掉。
2.希望可以方便的在图片上增加描述文字，做出来的效果类似于日本杂志那样。现在的备注在最下方，有点不起眼了。
3.因为衣帽间都有不同的衣柜。
希望给不同类型的衣服进行分区，比如说运动的、职场的、周末的。这样不会所有的衣服堆在同一个衣柜里，会比较混乱。
4.除了已经购买的衣服，希望可以增加梦想衣橱的功能。可以放在不同的文件夹或者专门标注出来。很多在收藏夹或者购物车里的衣服，我需要专门的文件夹来收藏，考察一下再下单购买，所以我很需要这样的一个功能。有时候也需要拿来和现有的衣服做搭配，来看看是否真的需要购买。

reviews.title: 一些使用建议
reviews.body:
1:希望抠图功能可以完善下，这个毛病真的很大。有时候自动抠图把需要的部分抠掉了，但是没有手动涂抹恢复的功能，如果不用自动抠图，自己用橡皮擦一点点擦又实在太麻烦了。

3:拼图那里希望从相册导入的时候就可以有一件抠图的功能，不用一件件抠。
4:输入一个衣服新品牌的时候，确认了之后希望可以自动填选该品牌，就不用从列表里再重新找出来了。
5:为什么导入穿搭的时候不可以多件自动抠图啊，像导入衣服那样。
6:如果能接入 AI 就好了，现在 ai 是大趋势。有些衣服不管是自己拍还是从网购网站拿的图都不够好看，而且不够清楚，能 ai 一件抠成白底图并且恢复衣服整体样貌就好了。
